headline: A 2014 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Galesburg, Illinois, after former Congressman Lane A. Evans.
what_it_does: The law gives a new official name to the Department of Veterans Affairs community based outpatient clinic at 310 Home Boulevard in Galesburg, Illinois. The new name is the "Lane A. Evans VA Community Based Outpatient Clinic." It does not change the clinic's services, staff, or hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
